So the substrate lives entirely at dimension (0,0,0). This is not a limitation to apologise for; it is the precise fact that makes DA.2's accounting exact.

steps.what: {hbar, c, G} is a DIMENSIONAL BASIS (det=2 != 0) -- exactly 3 anchors are irreducibly external
steps.why: the headline, and it is what makes Path B honest instead of a category error. Path B asked to 'derive hbar/c/G'. But dimension space (L,T,M) is a 3-dimensional vector space over the exponents, and {hbar, c, G} is a BASIS for it: their exponent matrix [[2,-1,1],[1,-1,0],[3,-2,-1]] has determinant 2, nonzero, so the three are independent and span. That is precisely why Planck units (l_P, t_P, m_P) exist and are unique -- every physical unit is a unique monomial hbar^a c^b G^d. Two consequences, both forced. (i) EXACTLY THREE dimensionful numbers are needed to fix every unit -- no fewer (the rank is 3), no more (three already span). (ii) The substrate is dimensionless (DA.1), so it supplies NONE of the three: a count times a count is a count, forever at (0,0,0); you cannot manufacture a metre from integers. Therefore >= 3 dimensionful inputs are IRREDUCIBLY EXTERNAL to the substrate -- they enter at MEASUREMENT (the Stones 17/18), exactly as maths-4 found ('the substrate's coupling is unity; alpha must enter where the substrate meets measurement'). This is not defeat: it is an exact ACCOUNTING -- it says how much is external (three numbers, the Planck scale) and, by DA.1, that everything else is the substrate's dimensionless business.

steps.why: the per-archon alpha, put on the ledger -- and it surfaces a conflation the source carries. alpha is read TWO ways in the corpus: 'energy per archon' (Stone 17, dimension energy (2,-2,1)) and the registration EDGE in c=alpha/tau (Kevin's Planck hypothesis 18.P.3: c a speed L/T, tau the tick T, so alpha=c*tau=length (1,0,0)). Those dimension vectors are DIFFERENT, so 'alpha' names two different objects unless one reading is wrong -- a real overload, exactly the kind the container discipline exists to catch. RUN IT: are they unrelated, or dual? Their dimensions SUM to (3,-2,1), which is the dimension of hbar*c -- so (energy alpha)*(length alpha) ~ hbar*c, i.e. E*R=hbar*c, which is LITERALLY Stone 17's cold algebra (17.S.1). The two readings are COMPTON-DUAL, not contradictory: the energy-alpha and the length-alpha are Compton conjugates, linked by hbar*c. And each one's units ARE a Planck monomial: 2*(energy alpha)=hbar+5c-G (the Planck energy sqrt(hbar c^5/G)), 2*(length alpha)=hbar+G-3c (the Planck length sqrt(hbar G/c^3)) -- both checked as integer exponent identities (the factor 2 clears the square roots). CONCLUSION: under either reading alpha = alpha_hat (dimensionless) x (a fixed Planck-unit anchor), so alpha's ABSOLUTE value carries units and needs the anchor; ONLY the dimensionless alpha_hat is the substrate's to force. The physical READING (which alpha, and that E*R=hbar*c is the registration boundary) stays Stone-quarantined; the DIMENSIONAL arithmetic here is what is derived.
